image_description: A vintage-style red and cream minibus driving on a city street. The vehicle has a boxy shape, large windshield, side windows, and visible wheels. The background features multi-story buildings with architectural details. The image has a slightly grainy, retro aesthetic.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Boxy body shape noticeably shorter than a full-size bus, yet tall enough for passengers to stand or sit upright comfortably.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle clearly exhibits a boxy, compact bus silhouette distinct from full-size coaches, with sufficient height for passenger accommodation.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large windshield and row of side windows along passenger area.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A large front windshield is prominent, and a clear row of rectangular side windows runs along the passenger compartment.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Height is substantial, with entrance door at front or mid-body.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The vehicle has substantial height relative to its width. A door structure is visible at the front-right side (from viewer's perspective), consistent with typical minibus layouts.
The panel lines near the front wheel arch indicate the presence of a folding or sliding door mechanism, typical for this vehicle class.
There is a distinct hood/bonnet section ahead of the windshield, indicating a front-engine layout rather than a cab-over design.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Rear flat or slightly angled panel with taillights and license plate mount.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The rear of the vehicle is not visible in this angle; only the front and right side are shown.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: White, yellow, or company livery paint with route markings.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The bus features a two-tone red and cream/white livery. There appears to be text/markings along the side skirt, though illegible due to resolution/style.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Standard van-sized wheels with steel or alloy rims.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible front and rear wheels are proportional to the vehicle size, resembling standard commercial van/truck wheels.
The window count and overall dimensions align with the capacity of a minibus (approx. 4-10 seats).

artifact_observations.reasoning: The text written along the lower side panel of the bus is illegible and resembles AI-generated gibberish or melted characters rather than clear typography.
The background architecture has a 'painterly' or overly smooth texture that lacks fine structural detail, blending slightly into the sky, which is common in generative models attempting retro styles.
The geometry of the front bumper and headlight assembly is slightly ambiguous and lacks sharp mechanical definition, appearing somewhat fused or soft.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific vehicle class and distinguish it from similar categories like full-size buses or vans.
To verify the 3D consistency of the vehicle against the background and check for spatial grounding errors.
To inspect the boundaries of the vehicle for edge bleeding, especially around the wheels and roofline.
To specifically analyze the illegible text on the side of the bus for artifact confirmation.
To assess the global coherence and detect any subtle stylistic inconsistencies or noise patterns.

focus_areas: Legibility and structure of side text/markings
Boundary sharpness between wheels and road
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the side of the bus; if it is gibberish, this is a strong indicator of AI generation. Also, evaluate if the 'retro' graininess is masking structural defects in the vehicle's geometry.
